name: Tempester n°33: the Load Sound knob remembers its position per sound folder
explanation: Tempester n°33: the Load Sound knob remembers its position per sound folder (Main 1.5.0.2, request #11). Before: the Sounds screen handler ([routine], s5 = ctx [address]) restarts the navigation whenever the selected pad differs from the pad of the navigation (ctx+0x71) or no navigation is running (ctx+0x3C = 0: boot, beat change, Revert Snd). The restart sets the index ctx+0x170 to 0, the folder ctx+0x172 to the folder of the pad's sound type ([routine], factory folders 0-9 only) and the count ctx+0x174 ([routine]), then loads index 0: the knob jumps back to the first sound of the folder at every pad. The Sound Folder knob sets the index to 0 at every folder change too. Docs/analyses/feature-cc-sliders-wheel.md (N°11), feature-ui-fixes.md. After: both paths call START instead of [routine]. START saves the index of the folder being left in a table of 14 u16 (one per folder: Kicks ... Misc, User 1-4), stores the new folder (the store the call sites made), counts the new folder, and sets the index to the table entry of the new folder, bounded by count - 1 (0 when the folder is empty): a folder that lost sounds is never read past its end. The first knob step on a new pad loads the sound the knob was on in that folder, the next step goes to the next sound. RAM: table [address]-[address] (gp - 0x7c50), in the .bss hole [address]-[address] that no load, store, gp address, lui pair (any distance) or data word of 1.6.2.0 reaches (Docs/analyses/feature-ui-fixes.md, RAM). The .bss is zeroed at boot: every folder starts at its first sound. The table survives beat changes and Revert Snd. Context: main loop (UI dispatch), as the code it replaces. Flasher page untouched.

edits.why: nop ; navigation restart: was "sh zero,0x170(s5)" (index = 0), now set by START from the folder's table entry
jal 0x9d07ce00 ; navigation restart: was "jal [address]" ([routine](0, folder of the pad's sound type)); a0 = 0, a1 = folder
nop ; delay slot: was "sh v0,0x172(s5)" (folder), now stored by START after the old folder is saved
nop ; Sound Folder knob: was "sh v0,0x172(s5)" (new folder), now stored by START after the old folder is saved
jal 0x9d07ce00 ; Sound Folder knob: was "jal [address]"; a0 = 0, a1 = new folder
nop ; delay slot: was "sh zero,0x170(s5)" (index = 0), now set by START
lhu t0,0x172(s5) ; folder of the last navigation (0 at boot)
beq t2,zero,0x9d07ce28 ; 14 folders: anything else is not saved
sh t1,-0x7c50(t3) ; table[old folder] = old index ([address] + 2 * folder)
jal [address] ; [routine](0, new folder): number of sounds
sh a1,0x172(s5) ; delay slot: ctx+0x172 = new folder (the store moved from the call sites)
or t4,zero,zero ; index 0 when the folder is empty or out of the table
lhu t4,-0x7c50(t3) ; remembered index of the new folder
addiu t4,v0,-0x1 ; the folder lost sounds: its last one
sh t4,0x170(s5) ; ctx+0x170 = index the caller loads ([address] / [address])
jr ra ; v0 = count, stored in ctx+0x174 by the caller
